items.title: Lamar Jackson: Gets in 'limited' work Wednesday
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Jackson got some "limited" work in with the team during Wednesday's practice, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Still sporting limp while walking
items.text:
Jackson was present for Wednesday's practice but didn't appear to participate in the session and was seen walking with a limp as he exited the field, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.
